related.title: Geneve：可變選項與解析邊界
related.titleEn: Geneve: variable options and parser boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受長度符合預算且跨VNI不可混用MAC學習項；本題未計入可選標籤。 交接時須能核對：交付 vxlan-ledger.csv、VNI對照表與過大封包反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require correct size and VNI-scoped MAC learning; optional tags are excluded from this fixture. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver vxlan-ledger.csv, VNI mappings and an oversized-packet counterexample.
related.difference: 建立option class/type/length表，逐項確認宣告長度與實際字節數。
related.differenceEn: Build option class/type/length entries and reconcile declared lengths with actual bytes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
VXLAN以UDP封裝內層Ethernet；VNI隔離語意不能由外層IP位址替代。
教學基準：1500-20-8-8-14 = 1450 B；對照：1500-40-8-8-14 = 1430 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Geneve選項長度可變；解析器必須先驗證長度，不能固定把內層封包放在相同偏移。
教學基準：1500-20-8-8-16-14 = 1434 B；對照：1500-20-8-8-32-14 = 1418 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
VXLAN encapsulates inner Ethernet in UDP; outer IP addresses do not substitute for VNI isolation.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-8-8-14 = 1450 B; comparison: 1500-40-8-8-14 = 1430 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Geneve options vary in length; a parser must validate lengths rather than assume a fixed inner-packet offset.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-8-8-16-14 = 1434 B; comparison: 1500-20-8-8-32-14 = 1418 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
